## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies DD2: /dso:retro has been invoked during the 4911 sprint, used bug-classification-stats.sh --window-days 60, and the retro output contains EITHER >= 1 MUST-surface labeled finding OR the exact text "Bug classification health: no threshold breaches in this window."

## Implementation Steps
1. Run stats script against live ticket data:
   bash plugins/dso/scripts/bug-classification-stats.sh --window-days 60

2. Capture the full stdout output

3. Verify output contains either:
   (a) A labeled finding line referencing a slug with count >= recurrence_threshold
   (b) OR the exact text: "Bug classification health: no threshold breaches in this window."

4. Record the output for DD3 evidence attachment.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -3
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] bug-classification-stats.sh exits 0 with valid output
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/bug-classification-stats.sh --window-days 60 && echo "PASS"
- [ ] Output contains uncategorized count line or health message
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/bug-classification-stats.sh --window-days 60 2>/dev/null | grep -E "(uncategorized:|Bug classification health:)" | head -1

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
data.title: [GREEN] Run bug-classification-stats.sh --window-days 60 and capture retro aggregation output
